cards.headline:
Google's rumored Fitbit Edge
puts Gemini on your wrist
cards.body: Google's rumored Fitbit Edge may pack a screen, GPS, Gemini coaching, and week-long battery into a tiny tracker.

blocks.x: Google's rumored Fitbit Edge could pack a screen, GPS, Gemini coaching, and week-long battery life into one tiny tracker. The device has not been announced; the details come from reports ahead of any official launch.

If the rumor holds, Google's Gemini-based health coaching would move onto a small, dedicated fitness tracker, which Digital Trends argues could make some buyers rethink whether they need a full smartwatch.

cards.headline:
Underdog brings a free AI
assistant fully on-device
cards.body: Sigil Wen's Underdog is an on-device AI assistant promising to be free, fully private, and capable for daily tasks.

blocks.x: Sigil Wen, backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, has launched Underdog, an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private, and capable for everyday tasks.
TechCrunch frames Underdog as the most private competitor yet to Instinct and Meta's Muse, because the assistant runs entirely on the user's own device.
